512-4188-4644.easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.

512-4188-4644.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4188-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Accomplished Alchemist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-2464-3249-5075--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-5075--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-5075--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-3249-3621-4549.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Relic of Legends's ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1283-1987-4423-7575.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's and Mystic Sanctuary's mana abilities by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U} that you can spend as though it were any color.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}{C}{C}, flickering Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters, Mystic Sanctuary and Tam trigger.
Resolve the Tam trigger, preparing them.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Cast a copy of Deep Sight from exile by paying {C}{C} and unpreparing Tam, drawing Ghostly Flicker and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

632-3621-4659-5129-7060.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-7060.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

465-3480-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.
